title: Adverb + Noun: Prepositional Phrases
lede: Build practical adverbial meaning with بِـ or فِي plus a noun, using natural phrasing and accurate genitive forms.

items.feedback: بِ + سُرْعَةٍ forms a common manner phrase.
The noun سُهُولَةٌ becomes genitive after بِ.
في + place noun creates a location phrase.

blocks: ## Why phrase-based adverbs matter
Arabic often expresses English “-ly” meanings through a short prepositional phrase. These chunks are highly useful because they expand ordinary verbs without requiring complex syntax.
### Core
Use common بِ + noun manner phrases and فِي + noun time/place phrases.
### Develop
Apply genitive endings and attach the preposition correctly in writing.
### Stretch
Compare synonymous direct adverbs and phrase-based alternatives, choosing the natural form for context.
## Diagnostic start
## بِـ + اِسْمٍ : expressing manner
The attached preposition بِـ can mean “with/by/in a manner of”. The following noun is genitive.

TABLE: Phrase | Meaning | Natural model // بِسُرْعَةٍ | quickly | أَكْمَلْتُ الْعَمَلَ بِسُرْعَةٍ. // بِبُطْءٍ | slowly | تَحَدَّثَ بِبُطْءٍ. // بِسُهُولَةٍ | easily | فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ بِسُهُولَةٍ. // بِصُعُوبَةٍ | with difficulty | وَجَدْنَا الْمَكَانَ بِصُعُوبَةٍ. // بِهُدُوءٍ | calmly/quietly | أَجَابَتْ بِهُدُوءٍ. // بِوُضُوحٍ | clearly | شَرَحَ الْمُعَلِّمُ الْقَاعِدَةَ بِوُضُوحٍ. // بِعِنَايَةٍ | carefully | اِقْرَأِ السُّؤَالَ بِعِنَايَةٍ. // بِأَمَانٍ | safely | وَصَلْنَا بِأَمَانٍ.
[example] سُرْعَةٌ بِـ + جَرّ بِسُرْعَةٍ
[ar] سُرْعَةٌ
[ar] بِسُرْعَةٍ
[callout/warning] Do not form phrases mechanically from any adjective. Learn the common noun-based chunk: بِسُرْعَةٍ , not بِسَرِيعٍ .
## فِي + اِسْمٍ : time and place
The same compact structure creates many everyday expressions for where and when an action happens.
### Place
فِي الْبَيْتِ فِي الْمَدْرَسَةِ فِي السُّوقِ فِي الْخَارِجِ فِي الدَّاخِلِ
### Time
فِي الصَّبَاحِ فِي الْمَسَاءِ فِي اللَّيْلِ فِي الشِّتَاءِ فِي الْمُسْتَقْبَلِ
[callout] Writing pattern: the preposition remains separate: فِي الْمَدْرَسَةِ . By contrast, بِـ attaches directly: بِسُرْعَةٍ , بِالْحَافِلَةِ .
## Position and sentence rhythm
A manner phrase usually follows the verb or its object. Time/place phrases can move for emphasis, but the sentence should remain clear.
[example] قَرَأْتُ النَّصَّ بِعِنَايَةٍ. natural I read the text carefully.
[ar] قَرَأْتُ النَّصَّ بِعِنَايَةٍ.
[example] فِي الصَّبَاحِ أَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ. time first In the morning, I read in the library.
[ar] فِي الصَّبَاحِ أَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ.
[callout] Layering information: أَكْمَلْتُ الْوَاجِبَ بِسُرْعَةٍ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ أَمْسِ. contains manner, place and time. Use only as much detail as the message needs.
## Apply and transform
### 📖 Reading
فِي الصَّبَاحِ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ بِالْحَافِلَةِ. أَجَبْتُ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ بِعِنَايَةٍ، وَلَكِنِّي أَكْمَلْتُ التَّمْرِينَ الأَخِيرَ بِصُعُوبَةٍ.
Label each phrase as time, place, means or manner.
### 🎧 Listening cloze
Ask a partner to omit the phrase from each sentence. Supply the most natural phrase from a bank and justify your choice.
### 🗣️ Instruction challenge
Explain how to complete a school task using بِعِنَايَةٍ، بِوُضُوحٍ، بِسُرْعَةٍ and one time/place phrase.
### 🛠️ Transformation drill
Transform adjective ideas into natural adverbial phrases: سَرِيعٌ، سَهْلٌ، وَاضِحٌ، هَادِئٌ، آمِنٌ . Do not simply attach بِ to the adjective.
### ✍️ How I complete a task
Write 90–110 words explaining how you study, cook, travel, exercise or use technology. Include at least six بِـ manner phrases and four فِي time/place phrases.
[callout] Model: فِي الْمَسَاءِ أَدْرُسُ فِي غُرْفَتِي. أَقْرَأُ التَّعْلِيمَاتِ بِعِنَايَةٍ، وَأَكْتُبُ إِجَابَاتِي بِوُضُوحٍ.
[callout] Success checklist: Place the phrase naturally; use the genitive form after every preposition; distinguish means (بالحافلة) from manner (بسرعة); avoid literal English translation.
Save and mark complete Clear
Plan a timeline, place map or sentence flowchart, then label it in Arabic with the target adverbs.
Complete the same task on paper. Circle each adverb or adverbial phrase and draw an arrow to the verb or sentence it modifies.
## Final mastery check
### Today you can
- build high-frequency manner phrases with بِـ;
- use فِي phrases for time and place;
- apply genitive forms after prepositions;
- choose natural Arabic chunks instead of translating mechanically.
